chunks: Those who listen to the Word and then follow the best it contains, are the ones who have been guided by God, and are men of wisdom.

key_terms.أُولُوا الْأَلْبَابِ: men of wisdom / people of intellect

ai.seo_question: Who are the people of understanding (Ulul Albab) according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the intellectual rigor of the Ahl al-Bayt, who exemplify the ability to sift through diverse narrations and select the most authentic and beneficial. It underscores that true 'ulū al-albāb' (people of intellect) are not passive listeners but active discerners who align their understanding with divine guidance. This process of critical evaluation is seen as a prerequisite for attaining spiritual and intellectual perfection.
